narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flooding and flash flooding across portions of central and southeast Virginia.
ev: Lane closures were reported due to standing water on Route 10 near Rushmere.
Lanes were closed on Route 673 near Lawson due to flash flooding.
Flash flooding was reported with some roads impassable.
Flash flooding was reported along London Boulevard.
Amster Road, Schloss Road, and Route 687 were flooded and impassable.
High water was reported at the intersection of Arrow Point Trail and West Providence Road.
Road was impassable due to flash flooding near the intersection of Gayton Road and Monmouth Drive.
Flooding was reported near Parham Road and Patterson Avenue. Some roads in the area were flooded and impassable.
